rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"Ignored-field handling switched from |= to &= corrupts nonPublic flag","detail":"The requirement does not ask for this change, and it breaks requirement N2. For fields marked [IgnoreMember], nonPublicMembersAreSerialized is now combined with &= instead of |=. The flag starts false, so an ignored non-public field can no longer set it. Worse, an ignored public field clears a flag that an earlier private keyed property (line 973) had set to true. Property handling at line 899 still uses |=, so properties and fields now behave differently. The flag controls several things: whether deferred diagnostics for non-public members are reported (line 1184), the MessagePackObjectAllowPrivateRequired check (line 1352) and the PartialTypeRequired / nested-formatter check (line 1382). Once it is cleared, a type with private keyed members can miss the AllowPrivate diagnostic and skip the partial-type check, and the generator can emit a nested formatter into a type that is not partial, which does not compile.
